business_problem: Geely needed a better way to connect directly with potential buyers, improve marketing precision, and treat customer interactions across pre-sales, sales, and after-sales stages as long-lived digital assets instead of isolated campaigns.
solution_summary: Geely Auto used Tencent to build and strengthen a marketing data middle platform that connects customer traffic, identity, and campaign execution across the whole vehicle lifecycle. Tencent's approach starts with the "AR Cubed" growth model, which links pre-sales, sales, and after-sales stages across acquisition, activation, retention, conversion, referral, and store-visit journeys. A One ID system unifies public-domain traffic from digital, social, and content media with private-domain traffic from the website, official social accounts, app, mini-programs, and official mall. On top of that identity foundation, a CDP user-data platform and Enterprise WeChat automotive workflows give marketers and sales teams a data-driven private-domain operating model. The resulting data assets feed strategy iteration, more precise customer matching, and closed-loop performance analysis, helping Geely shift from one-way promotion to continuous digital customer operations.

solution_components.name: Marketing Data Middle Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared marketing data layer that accumulates and reuses customer assets.

solution_components.name: AR Cubed Growth Model
solution_components.role: Organizes lifecycle growth operations across pre-sales, sales, and after-sales stages.

solution_components.name: One ID System
solution_components.role: Unifies customer identities across public- and private-domain traffic sources.

solution_components.name: CDP User Data Platform
solution_components.role: Turns unified customer data into audience insights and operational intelligence.

solution_components.name: Enterprise WeChat Automotive Edition
solution_components.role: Connects sales and marketing teams to customers through a private-domain engagement workflow.

data_flow: Public-domain media traffic and private-domain touchpoints from the website, social accounts, app, mini programs, and official mall flow into the One ID and CDP layers, where Geely builds lifecycle audiences and then activates them through Enterprise WeChat-led sales and marketing operations.
business_outcome: Geely gained a data-backed operating model for direct customer reach, more precise lifecycle marketing, and closed-loop feedback from interactions back into sales and campaign strategy.
architecture_clues: The lifecycle model explicitly spans pre-sales, sales, and after-sales stages.
One ID unifies public-domain and private-domain traffic into a single customer view.
The architecture centers on a CDP and Enterprise WeChat-led private-domain marketing model.
